units: <cite ref="Pesachim 114a:2">Pes. 114ᵃ</cite> <he>פְּחוֹת ממיכלך וכ׳</he> diminish from (spend less for) thy eating and drinking, and add to thy dwelling.—Part. pass. <cite ref="Q00474"><he>פָּחִית</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to become defective, be broken, damaged. Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᵇ bot., v. אֲיָירָא.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 62a">Keth. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>איפ׳ בי בנא וכ׳</he> the floor of the bath-house under him gave way.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 892:1">Yalk. Deut. 892</cite> <he>אי׳ ליה שנה מן שנה שנה עליו עידנא</he> (not <cite ref="O01410"><he>לה</he></cite>) his crop grew less from year to year; time changed for him (nature changed on his account); Tanḥ. R’eh 10 <he>מי פחת וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.).
